name: Griblje
snippet: Griblje is a settlement on the left bank of the Kolpa River in the Municipality of Črnomelj in the White Carniola area of southeastern Slovenia.

name: Pond in Griblje
snippet: This small, but beautiful, pond is not well known, except to locals. It lies in the fields between the villages of Griblje and Krasinec.
